references.title: DWDS: Getreide
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: ahd. gitregidi 'Ertrag', a collective on tragen whose sense and letters left it

notes.rationale: grain. The ge- is fossilized: no Wortzerlegung confirms the cut, so it stays inside the Root. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word: the Root getreid and the Ending e (ADR 0051).
